restrictions: Target sha256-r31-prefix-v1: SHA-256 compression steps 0..30 inclusive on every padded block, standard fixed IV once at the start, FIPS 180-4 padding, full feed-forward, full 256-bit big-endian digest; ordinary collision of two distinct finite byte strings.

This is a GENUINE fresh-run forward search, not a replay: fresh uniform random first blocks M0, CV=C(IV,M0), a probe of a table merged from K=400 completion-compatible starting points, and a hard-capped completion. Two-block messages M0||M1 and M0||M1' of 128 bytes share M0 and differ only in second-block words W5..W9 by d5..d9.

Trials are independent by construction (fresh uniform coins). success_probability 0.46 is derived from EXACT binomial tails over the hard per-run caps: with per-trial real win probability q_D = 2^-40.691 and N = 2^40, 1-(1-q_D)^N - p_cap = 0.4617 >= 0.46 >= 0.39 (p_cap = 3.3e-16). Not an expectation and not a single observed run; the time bound holds for every run.

The K=400 starting points are the first SOLVER-generated (STP + CryptoMiniSat) completion-compatible points for this characteristic, each provably closing steps 13..18 (conditions P4, V9, and joint step-13..18 closure; proof.md Section 5 and Appendices B, C). The characteristic is the attributed Li-Liu-Wang EUROCRYPT 2024 Sect 4.2 trail; the compatible starting points, the merged table, the ledger and the exact-binomial derivation are ours.

The construction is fully specified in proof.md: characteristic and signed condition table, exact differences/constants, the exact admissible sets V5..V8/V9/G16/G18/S with enumerated sizes, the completion-compatibility predicate, the Phase-1 table equations, the merged exact-union match set P, the cap16 forward search, and the capped completion. No external paper is relied upon for the specification.

HARD PER-RUN LEDGER: one target compression costs 1 unit; every other 256-bit word primitive (load, store, add/sub, AND/OR/XOR/NOT, shift/rotate, compare, branch, and each independent uniform random word) costs 1/2140 unit. Each trial is charged, as a hard worst case, one compression + 2 fresh random 256-bit word draws + 30 fixed extraction/lookup word ops + cap16 group work (<=16 tuples * 38 word ops), i.e. 1 + 640/2140 = 1.2990654 units; randomness is never omitted. All N=2^40 trials including failures are charged (T2 = 2^40.3775); all preprocessing (K STP solves T0=2^36.10, table build T1=2^30, completions T3=2^32.6) is charged once; no amortization and no parallel wall-time discount. Total = 2^40.4572, time_log2 = 40.46.

The per-tuple acceptance sets are NOT pairwise disjoint; Pr[CV in P] = |P|/2^96 = 2^-36.8141 uses the EXACT UNION over all 4771060 merged tuples of all K=400 starting points (exact-union deficit validated <= 5.5e-7 relative), never the sum of sizes and never a distinct-key or Poisson-bucket assumption.

Memory is a reported metric only, with no scalar contribution and no tie-break; memory_log2_bytes = 32 is reported but is NOT a declared heuristic. baseline_improved = sha256-r31-nominal-v2 is a required reference identifier and does not itself assert an improvement.

Certificates are eight distinct verified self-found/completion colliding pairs with the organizer target profile, re-hashed by the organizer. The organizer completion experiment (experiments/completion.py) is byte-identical to the validated program and exercises the capped completion that H2 depends on.

heuristics.statement: For CV = C(IV, M0) from a uniform 512-bit first block, the real one-trial winning probability is at least one half of its value under a uniform CV, while the probability that CV lies in the match set P is at most a bounded factor times the exact uniform value |P|/2^96 = 2^-36.8141, where |P| is the exact (non-disjoint) union over all 4771060 merged tuples of all K=400 compatible starting points.
heuristics.scope: One 31-step reduced SHA-256 compression from the standard IV on a uniform first block, restricted to the three backward state words (A_-1, A_-2, A_-3), against the fixed merged table P built independently of the trials.
heuristics.extrapolation: From the exact enumeration of the condition sets and the exact union count of P (Pr_U = 2^-36.8141, bracket [-36.8141, -36.8141], deficit <= 5.5e-7), plus leading-matching-bit checks over our own random-first-block runs and the organizer-verified certificates, to the full 96-bit membership probability and the half-ratio on the complete winning probability. The set cardinalities and the exact union are facts; only the near-uniformity of CV on these 96 bits and the half/factor bounds are extrapolated.
heuristics.limitations: CV is produced by a real 31-step compression, not an ideal permutation; only leading matching bits can be sampled directly and the full 96-bit event cannot be exhaustively observed. Sensitivity: the per-trial win probability scales linearly with |P|/2^96 and with the half-ratio; achieved 1-(1-q_D)^N-p_cap = 0.4617 at N=2^40 (N*q_D=0.6194); 0.39 needs N*q_D>=0.494, so the effective q (Pr_U, the H1 half-ratio, or r_comp) may fall to 0.798x of nominal before 0.39 is threatened. r_comp=1.000 is measured (compatible points complete deterministically).

heuristics.statement: Conditioned on a uniform chaining value lying in P and having c18 in S, the declared capped Phase-3 completion (CAP13 = 2^18, CAP15 = 2^12, global stop 2^16 inner iterations, fresh per-candidate offsets) succeeds with probability at least r_comp = 1.000; the probability that a matched prefix has c18 in S is exactly |S|/2^32 = 0.1361322.
heuristics.scope: Phase 3 (completion) of the attack on a matched prefix, on the selected target sha256-r31-prefix-v1, under the exact declared caps and fresh-offset process; r_comp = 1.000 is measured over the compatible starting points, which close deterministically.
heuristics.extrapolation: From the organizer completion experiment on the published prefix (many organizer seeds, fresh offsets, global cap, 256/256) and our own completion runs over the K=400 compatible points (completion_rate 1.000), to the completion rate over the distribution of matched prefixes the forward search produces. The c18-in-S fraction 0.1361322 is exact.
heuristics.limitations: The organizer experiment exercises one fixed prefix with many offsets, so it tests the routine and its caps, not the full spread over prefixes from the K merged compatible points. Sensitivity: success is linear in r_comp through q; achieved 1-(1-q_D)^N-p_cap = 0.4617 at N=2^40 (N*q_D=0.6194); 0.39 needs N*q_D>=0.494, so the effective q (Pr_U, the H1 half-ratio, or r_comp) may fall to 0.798x of nominal before 0.39 is threatened. r_comp=1.000 is measured (compatible points complete deterministically).

heuristics.statement: All computation that produced the K=400 completion-compatible starting points merged into the table -- the STP + CryptoMiniSat solves extended to close steps 13..18, including failed and abandoned branches -- costs at most T_sp = 73568092160 = 2^36.10 target-compression units, a preprocessing term about 4.3 bits below the dominant trials term 2^40.3775; so preprocessing_log2 = 36.24 and total time_log2 = 40.46.
heuristics.scope: Phase-0 generation of the K=400 compatible starting points by our solver (not the online search), charged once as preprocessing; the dominant per-run cost is the N=2^40 forward-search trials (T2 = 2^40.3775), not this term.
heuristics.extrapolation: From the MEASURED sum of the K points' solve CPU-seconds (8769.7 CPU-s) converted at the declared conservative charge 8388608 = 2^23 target-compression units per CPU-second to T_sp = 2^36.10. Because this term is >4 bits below the trials term, the total time_log2 is insensitive to the conversion.
heuristics.limitations: The CPU-second-to-unit charge is a stated conservative calibration, not an organizer-model instruction trace, and the solver is a single heuristic run; as a preprocessing term well below the dominant trials cost it only moves the total marginally. Sensitivity: 1x T_sp -> time_log2 40.46; 2x T_sp -> time_log2 40.53; 4x T_sp -> time_log2 40.65; 8x T_sp -> time_log2 40.88; the trials term continues to dominate.
